record_format_note: Draft format (spec §5.7-5.9, §9.4 sketch), with a per-bar crawl walk.

performance.title: The C major Prelude, harmony only (after Bach, BWV 846): crawl walk

performer.name: Astrid, NetComposer Algorithmic Performer (stand-in scripts on the box, not the netcomposer CLI)

rules_set_by.note: Composition gives only chords, bars and tempo shape. The timbre travels: each bar's sounds are found by following links from the previous bar's sounds.

composition_ref.music: Johann Sebastian Bach, Prelude in C major, BWV 846 (1722). Public domain.

analysis.credit: Mark Gotham et al., When in Rome corpus

composition_ref.not_used: Bach's written notes. No score, MIDI or kern file is read.

rule_set.name: crawl walk (BWV 846)
rule_set.walk: Bar 1 starts from the two sounds bar 1 of the search-driven take used. For each bar, up to three of the previous bar's sounds are expanded, rotating hop types: Freesound similar sounds (other contributors only), a tag of the sound, its pack or its user. Every 3rd bar adds a Wikimedia Commons search and every 4th bar (from bar 2) an Internet Archive search, using a tag or title word of a current sound. If a chord tone is still missing, the next hop asks Freesound's own pitch descriptor for it (same tag where possible). Up to 6 rounds per bar.
rule_set.selection: From sounds found in this bar or the previous one: per chord tone the best sound with a measured segment on that tone (NC's own analysis: dominant pitch class, within 25 cents of A440, low noise), preferring new contributors and new sounds; then extra sounds up to 7. Max 2 sounds per contributor per bar.
rule_set.rhythm: Each bar's rhythm donor is a found sound with 6+ onsets; 4-8 of its onsets, time-scaled to a half bar, are the attacks (twice per bar). Brightness at each onset picks the register, level picks the gain; the least-used nearby sound is chosen so events spread across contributors.
rule_set.bass: Found segment on the written bass (else the root), low and fundamental-dominant, rotating (not the previous bar's).
rule_set.bed: Found segment whose measured pitch classes all sit in the chord (70%+ chroma energy), time-stretched to the bar.
